messages:
Alex (oncall): morning handoff — quick summary of what ran overnight and current status
incident-bot: Pager #1389 triggered 2026-03-14T03:12:07Z -> kv-cache eviction storm in eu-west, elevated 502/504 to the router layer
Alex (oncall): saw a spike in p95/token latency for long-context (>8k) generation paths around 03:10 UTC, followed by steady 502s for ~18m
Maria (secondary): confirmed customer-facing errors for two clients on eu-west, both long-context sessions timed out. Support ticket numbers: SUP-8841, SUP-8842
Lina (support): both customers got fallbacks but experienced degraded quality. CSMs notified, awaiting more logs for SUP-8842
Jordan (devops): we attempted soft-fallback routing to dedicated-capacity-pool-2 (dc-pool-2) at 03:25 UTC; that reduced 502 rate by ~70% but latency still elevated for >12k token sessions
Ravi (sre): root cause looks like coordinated KV eviction + high mem pressure on a subset of nginx proxies -> caused client connections to reset. Eviction triggered by a burst of embeddings jobs from internal eval job eval/crashpad-2026-03
Alex (oncall): what mitigations applied and what remains?
Jordan (devops): actions taken overnight:
- scaled dc-pool-2 +2 nodes at 03:30
- disabled continuous batching for long-context routes at 03:35 (`/v1/generate?context=long`)
- increased kv cache retention for hot prefixes (temporary)
Result: error rate back to baseline ~04:00 UTC for short requests, partial restoration for long requests
Maria (secondary): open risk: autoscaler might re-add batching if thresholds hit. Added a temporary autoscaler override to keep batching off for long-context for 2h
Tess (product): customers affected: two enterprise customers on dedicated. Both are on tickets and CSMs looped in. Any ETA for full recovery for >12k token sessions?
Ravi (sre): ETA unclear — need to let new nodes warm and monitor KV hot-key stabilization. Tentative 2-6 hours for full stabilization unless another eviction cycle occurs
Alex (oncall): runbook pointers for incoming shift: see runbook link -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction and dashboard -> https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/ops/kv-eviction?from=now-6h To reproduce check logs:
```
# check eviction events
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=kv-cache -c manager --since=6h | grep Evict
# quick error rate
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?m=router.errors.p95&region=eu-west" | jq
```
Maria (secondary): I'll be primary for the next 2.5 hours, then @Ravi takes over at 11:30 UTC. Primary/secondary schedule: Alex (now) -> Maria (until 11:30) -> Ravi -> Jordan (backup)
Alex (oncall): coverage notes: no on-call gaps today, but we have limited second-tier for eu-west between 09:30-10:15 UTC (Ravi on calls). If something pages during that window escalate to Jordan
Jordan (devops): note to next shift — if 502s spike again, quick mitigation sequence:
1) set `batching.long_context.enabled=false` in config service
2) scale dc-pool-2 by +3 nodes (`./scripts/scale_pool dc-pool-2 3`)
3) temporarily route traffic from `eu-west-read` to `eu-central-1` for non-SLA traffic via router policy `soft-failover`
Lina (support): I'm tracking customer comms. If recovery >2h, we should prepare a templated status update for the two customers (cc CSMs). I'll draft and paste here if needed :memo:
Alex (oncall): action items for next shift (short):
- keep batching disabled for long-context routes (Maria/Jordan)
- monitor kv eviction metric and mem_pressure alerts (Ravi)
- verify evaluate job eval/crashpad-2026-03 is rate-limited (DevEx)
- support: standby for CSM updates (Lina)
Ravi (sre): I'll also add a temporary alert to notify if evictions/sec > 5 for 3m
OpsBot: scheduled check-in reminder set for 10:00 UTC (6381237200)
Maria (secondary): acknowledged. I'll run through the runbook in the first 15m and post any deviations here
Tess (product): please add a note to the incident tracker IN-4321 with customer impact and mitigation timeline once you have the stabilization graph
Alex (oncall): confirmed. I'll update IN-4321 before handing off. Final note: no current pages, p95 for short-gen stable, we'll reconvene at OpsBot check-in or earlier if paged. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager #1389 resolved at 04:12:03Z (auto-closed) - monitoring continues
Maria (secondary): last check 08:25 UTC, errors low but p95 still ~1.6x baseline for >10k tokens. keeping watch — will escalate if >2x
Ravi (sre): leaving a sticky: check `kernel.max_map_count` on the warmed nodes if evictions recur; seen related mem fragmentation before
Alex (oncall): handoff complete — next sync if anything changes.
